name: arch-review
description: Architecture review gate for TheChasIX.com. Auto-injects current architecture rules from AGENTS.md and Plan_WebArchitecture.md into a compliance checklist, then writes DESIGN_REVIEW_<date>_<slug>.md to .opencode/reviews/.
enforcement: advisory (pre-commit hook warns on new src/templates/* or src/api/* files without any review on file)
